# Observations (reproducible experiments we ran)

## OBS-0001

How each REPDF class changes the bytes (all 1,000 files vs their originals): C1 overwrites 11-12 of the first 12 bytes; C2 removes 2.4-39 KB (the classic xref); C3 removes 23-215 bytes; C4 removes 45-128 bytes around the page tree; C5 removes exactly 8 bytes (an object header); C10 keeps exactly 70% of bytes.

- Result: Per class x creation method (min/median/max in summary.json). C1: 12-byte span, 11-12 differing bytes. C5: size delta -8 in all 100 files. C10: kept fraction 0.7 in all 100 files. C2 saveas -21294..-39094 bytes, print -2452..-3972. C3 saveas -210..-215, print -23..-24. C4 -45..-128.
- Reproduce: `python3 research/experiments/corpus_characterize.py /home/user/dfrc-korea/repdf research/experiments/results/corpus_characterize`
- Script: `research/experiments/corpus_characterize.py` · Result file: `research/experiments/results/corpus_characterize.summary.json`

## OBS-0002

REPDF's C9 files are not single-byte corruptions: each of the 100 C9 files differs from its original in 12-30 bytes spread across 11-28 distinct stream bodies (size unchanged), contradicting the paper's 'modifying a random byte' (CLM-0026).

- Result: C9/saveas diff_bytes 13/21/29, streams_hit 11/17/28; C9/print diff_bytes 12/22.5/30, streams_hit 12/18/26 (min/median/max). Replacement bytes are varied (top replacement byte covers <=4% of changes).
- Reproduce: `python3 research/experiments/corpus_characterize.py /home/user/dfrc-korea/repdf research/experiments/results/corpus_characterize`

## OBS-0003

REPDF's C7 and C8 do not delete font data: they overwrite it in place with ASCII spaces (0x20), keeping the file size, so every xref offset stays valid. 100% of changed bytes are 0x20 in all 200 C7/C8 files.

- Result: C7 saveas/print and C8 saveas/print: size_delta 0 in all files; top replacement byte 0x20 with share 1.0 in every file; changed bytes 165 KB-2.9 MB per file; C7 touches 11-22 streams, C8 19-44 (adds ToUnicode).
- Reproduce: `python3 research/experiments/corpus_characterize.py /home/user/dfrc-korea/repdf research/experiments/results/corpus_characterize`
- Script: `research/experiments/corpus_characterize.py` · Result file: `research/experiments/results/corpus_characterize.summary.json`
